claim: The isolated T082 state machine activates only healthy immutable releases and can roll application traffic back while preserving the forward database schema.

commands.command: Python compile, bash -n, YAML parse, Prettier and git diff --check

negative_paths: contract phase rejected during rollback window
interrupted receipt sink reconciled through the state-embedded receipt

included: T082 release packaging and provider-neutral candidate runtime
application rollback runbook and isolated evidence
excluded: production deployment or provider traffic switch
destructive schema rollback or contract migration

limitations: The local runner does not match the pinned Node/pnpm toolchain, so full repository validation remains exact-head CI evidence.
Docker and Gradle are unavailable locally; OCI build, image provenance and vulnerability evidence remain exact-head CI/Security gates.
No production environment, database, provider, credential or public traffic switch was accessed.
Production activation, contract migration, protected merge and the T082 checkbox remain accountable human gates.
